Piers Morgan Sets Sights on U.S. Midterm Elections With Live YouTube Strategy

30 Oct 2026, 01:37 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: www.hollywoodreporter.com

Key takeawaysTelevision personality and digital creator Piers Morgan is preparing a live four-hour election night broadcast for his "Uncensored" YouTube channel, targeting American midterm election coverage from a custom Washington, D.C., set. According to an interview with *The Hol

Television personality and digital creator Piers Morgan is preparing a live four-hour election night broadcast for his "Uncensored" YouTube channel, targeting American midterm election coverage from a custom Washington, D.C., set.

According to an interview with *The Hollywood Reporter*, Morgan and his team plan to broadcast from 7 p.m. to 11 p.m., utilizing a backdrop featuring the U.S. Capitol Building. While the show traditionally operates on a pre-recorded schedule, the live election night event will serve as a major test for the channel's digital-first format.

Strategy and Non-Partisan Positioning

Morgan emphasized that his platform aims to offer an alternative to traditional, highly partisan news outlets, positioning himself outside traditional left-right or Democrat-Republican boxes. Rather than attempting to rival legacy networks like CNN or NBC in breaking down granular, real-time vote tallies, Morgan stated that his broadcast will focus on rolling analysis, commentary, and discussion featuring recurring channel contributors and newsmakers.

Rashida Jones, CEO of Uncensored, noted that the broadcast will lean into digital flexibility rather than attempting to replicate traditional election night watch parties or data boards. YouTube reported that over 45 million viewers watched election-related coverage on the platform during the 2024 election cycle, highlighting a substantial audience for digital-native political commentary.

Growth of the Uncensored Brand

The upcoming midterm special arrives amid a period of organizational expansion for Uncensored. The company raised $27 million in a funding round led by Greece's Antenna Group and Raine Ventures, reaching a reported valuation of $145 million. Following the investment, the platform hired former MSNBC president Rashida Jones to spearhead new verticals, including history, football, and royal coverage, alongside a newly launched subscription tier offering ad-free viewing and bonus content.

Morgan pointed to his recent interview with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy—which garnered over a million views on YouTube and widespread international coverage—as evidence of digital media's growing influence over legacy news agendas. He also cited the shifting habits of younger demographics, whose average media consumption heavily favors digital platforms over traditional cable news.

Practical Implications and Verification

Readers interested in verifying the original announcement and monitoring updates regarding the upcoming broadcast can access the complete report directly through The Hollywood Reporter.

  • Confirmed Details: Uncensored is planning a live four-hour election night broadcast from Washington, D.C.; the company recently secured $27 million in funding at a $145 million valuation; and leadership plans to expand into subscription tiers and linear television partnerships.
  • Unknowns: Specific guest lineups, exact timing adjustments, and final technical execution details for the live stream remain unannounced.
  • Reader Guidance: Audiences should consult official Uncensored channel announcements for scheduling confirmations closer to the broadcast date.
